text:
The plate spans about 400 px in the image. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that is roughly 15 px per cm.

The meat pieces are slices of steak, perhaps flank or skirt, coated in herb sauce such as chimichurri. The cluster runs about 215 px long, which is roughly 14 cm. It holds about 3-4 thin slices, each around 10 cm by 3 cm and 0.8 cm thick, so about 25 cm³ per slice. That gives roughly 80 g in total, and I'll call it 90 g with the herb sauce and oil.

Cooked steak runs about 200 kcal per 100 g, and the oily herb sauce adds some energy. That comes to about 190 kcal.
